dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Oh, you're back! Hold still, I'm going to do a quick checkup... Extremities look fine, mental state appears sound...

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Yep... Looks like you've made it back unscathed! Good job!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Yes! This place is so bright and open — it's nothing like living underwater. Plus, the layout really reflects your personality. It feels novel but also comfortable.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: I took a look around. There doesn't seem to be a production zone, and no one's busying themselves earning Credit Coupons... It's the sort of place where you can relax your mind and body.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: But I guess that means nutritious meals aren't an imperative around here... Hmm, I'll just have to find some other way to look after everyone's health, then.

choices.text: You don't need to worry about work here.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Hehe, it's no problem. It doesn't feel like work, anyway. You could say it's more of a hobby or a passion... Maybe a bit of both!

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Let's see... How many years has it been...? Well, I might not know how long I've been working, but I do know I've enjoyed every second of it！

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Of course, an empty infirmary makes me happier still, because that means everyone is healthy!

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Oh, that reminds me, my medicine kit is almost empty!

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Would you mind purchasing some ingredients for me the next time you're out? Here's the list.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Oh, and here's some Mora, too. Tell me if it wasn't enough, okay? I'll be sure to make up the difference.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: There's no need to exchange Mora between us.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Huh...? Oh, I see... We'll use Credit Coupons, then!

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Yep! You don't need to worry, though. Figuring out what that method should be is my job!

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: I'll be sure not to cause any trouble. You won't even notice anything!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Sure! I love talking to people!

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: We Melusines are extra perceptive, I can generally tell where a patient is hurting just by observing them and asking a few questions.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: But if you want to get to the root of the problem, a few simple questions alone won't do.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Chatting with a patient about their interests, hobbies, lifestyle, even their feelings... can be much more beneficial to figuring out the best way to treat them.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: You think so? I'm happy to hear that.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: I often get such compliments from everyone at the Fortress of Meropide as well. You all are so cute!

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Humanity's trust is very important to me. It's what gives people the confidence to place their health in my care.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Are there ever people who don't cooperate?

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Of course. After all... Everyone has their little secrets. It's normal for someone to have things they aren't willing to share.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Not too long ago, I had a patient who'd always come to the infirmary with injured fingers. Every time, he would argue that all he needed were some bandages and painkillers, and he'd be on his way.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: But one glance was all I needed to tell exactly what he was hiding.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: His finger injuries weren't any real concern. His extreme mental fatigue and lack of focus, however, were. I could see that he was at his limit.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So what did you do?

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: It was quite tricky. After all, I could only help him if he opened up to me.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: "Oh my, look at this hand... *sigh* It won't be long before..."

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Maybe what I said scared him, because he then waited for the other patients to leave the infirmary, before immediately telling me the truth.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You hornswoggled him...

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Oh, no, not at all. What I meant to say was, "It won't be long before you make a full recovery." I just didn't finish my sentence.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: As it turned out, his roommate had finished his prison sentence, leaving him alone in the dormitory. Being afraid of the dark, he couldn't sleep at night, leading to extreme fatigue and frequent work accidents.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: He was afraid people would make fun of his phobia, especially considering his formidable appearance, so he was too embarrassed to tell anyone.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: But, it turned out alright in the end. I took him to fill out a dormitory transfer request with Ms. Monglane, and the problem was solved.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: That experience taught me a lot about the extent to which some choose to keep up appearances even at the cost of their health.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's true...

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Well, what about you? Do you have any secrets you find difficult to share?

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: If you want to avoid certain health issues in the future, you might consider talking about them. In any case, I'm always here if you want to talk.

choices.text: I'm sure everyone enjoys talking to you.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Hmm. I've heard that many people develop a fear of doctors and nurses at a young age or react strongly to the smell of certain medicines.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Luckily, people usually don't have any reservations about coming to the infirmary over in the Fortress.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Most of my patients are very cooperative and will answer all my questions.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you want to do?

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Ah, looks like you've got some free time right now too!

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Want to try my new skincare product? It's a face cream.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: As far as I know, no product now on the market can accomplish that.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: If someone tries to sell you a product like that, I'd suggest reporting them to the Gardes. I imagine a trip to the Fortress of Meropide will be added to their itinerary.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Anyway, it's best not to have unrealistic expectations when it comes to skincare products. I think humans look cute no matter what!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What sort of appearance would you consider most beautiful?

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Sorry, but I'm not sure I can answer that question. I don't place humans in one category or the other. I think everyone has a unique charm.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Plus, no one has the right to comment on someone else's appearance or compare them to others.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Even the Iudex himself doesn't have the right to pass such judgment. Not that he would do that anyway, though.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Most of the letters I receive in Beautes en fleurs are from people lamenting their looks or searching for ways to improve how they look.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: *sigh* Sometimes I just don't understand why humans are so hard on themselves.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: I share beauty tips to teach people how to appreciate the appearance they already have. By learning how to look after their skin, they can also learn to love themselves.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: That includes you... It's good to care about how you look. But first, you have to recognize how cute you already are!

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Hehe. Glad I could help.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Anyway... Let's get to testing that product, shall we?

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: I can't wait to see how you look covered in purple face cream!

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: That's the spirit, hehe!

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: If you think of your appearance at any given moment as a photo you want to put on display, then skincare would be the photo frame.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: It protects the picture, enhances its appearance, and gives it a unique touch.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: But a frame that covers up the picture would defeat the purpose, right? That would be such a pity.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Sigewinne.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Morning! Oh dear, look at those dark circles...

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Let me get a Tidalga compress on your eyes before you go out today. Don't worry, it'll be nice and cool.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Sigewinne.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Ah, are you going to bed? Mind if I stand next to you and keep track of your sleep data?

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Don't worry. I'll only monitor your breathing and body temperature, and I'll ignore anything you say in your sleep. You won't even know I'm there.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Wow, this brings back memories! No matter how much time passes, this warm atmosphere always puts me at ease...

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Ah, I really miss the taste of Poissonchant Pie. Why don't you head inside and take a seat? I'll prepare the ingredients, and we'll be eating in no time!

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Remember to crouch a little when you go inside. I don't want you to bump your head.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Aha, where there's fighting, there's accidents. Looks like my services could really be of use here.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: That way, you won't need to relocate the injured. I'll just treat them here.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: In the meantime, I'll sit back and admire the lithe human musculature and twisted facial expressions, hehe.
